title: SessionExport
description: Pack a closed session for another node (protocol.md §4.11): its runtime transcript and a snapshot of every checkout (commits not on any remote plus uncommitted and untracked files, as a git bundle). The daemon uploads the archive with PUT /nodes/moves/{export_id} and answers session.exported. Sent after the session's session.close, on the same lane.

repos.description: The session's git checkouts (relative to the root), snapshotted in this order.
